bodySections.heading: Why timing matters for this schedule
paragraphs: The Entlebucher Mountain Dog core series (DA2PP / DHPP plus rabies per law) is plotted at 8, 12, 16, 16 weeks in the table above so a medium puppy is covered as maternal antibodies fade.
At 40-55 lb (18-25 kg), Entlebucher Mountain Dog visit logistics matter as much as antigens: book the 16-week appointment before class, daycare, or boarding asks for proof.
Bring hip dysplasia and progressive retinal atrophy (pra) into the Entlebucher Mountain Dog exam-room conversation while you are already there for shots.

Rabies for a Entlebucher Mountain Dog still follows local statute, and when the clinic allows you can pair it with the ≥16-week core finish, then photograph the certificate into PetClues the same day.

bodySections.heading: If a dose is missed or delayed
paragraphs: Owners postpone Entlebucher Mountain Dog shots when the puppy seems “a little off,” travel intervenes, or hip dysplasia worries dominate the week — ask the clinic whether a same-week Entlebucher Mountain Dog make-up is still appropriate instead of sliding to the annual exam.
Long gaps can leave Entlebucher Mountain Dog antibody levels uncertain, so expect either an added booster or a titer conversation rather than a shrug.
Do not trade the missed Entlebucher Mountain Dog dose for extra socialization; finish immunity first for this medium dog.
Reset the Entlebucher Mountain Dog reminder stack the evening of the make-up appointment — including the eventual adult booster after the 16-week finish.

faqs.question: When does the Entlebucher Mountain Dog core vaccine series usually finish?
faqs.answer: This breed record completes core vaccines around 16 weeks of age, with rabies timed per local law. Your clinic may adjust intervals for the individual puppy.

faqs.question: What should I do if my Entlebucher Mountain Dog misses a booster?
faqs.answer: Contact your veterinarian for a catch-up plan instead of restarting or skipping ahead. Keep prior dates handy and limit high-risk exposure until the series is current again.

faqs.question: Where can I read Entlebucher Mountain Dog health context beyond vaccines?
faqs.answer: See the Entlebucher Mountain Dog adult health guide for breed predispositions such as hip dysplasia, then bring those notes to wellness and vaccine visits.
